h: Super Eagles climb to 29th in FIFA rankings despite Tanzania draw
p: Nigeria have moved up one place to 29th in the latest FIFA world rankings and are back in Africa's top five. The boost comes despite the goalless draw with Tanzania that hurt their AFCON hopes.
body: Nigeria's Super Eagles have moved up one place to 29th in the latest FIFA world rankings, ending their 2026 international calendar with a small boost.
The Super Eagles climbed from 30th to 29th in the world and moved back into Africa's top five, after slipping out of that group earlier in the year.

Nigeria beat Tanzania 3-1 in Uyo before playing out a goalless draw in the return leg in Zanzibar. The draw left them on seven points, three behind group leaders Guinea-Bissau, making their path to AFCON 2027 more complicated.
more: Nigeria are now 29th in the world.
They are back in Africa's top five.
Their AFCON 2027 hopes remain in doubt.
